alignment.accounting: sum of training, validation, diagnostics and failed/timeout worker durations; final test separately reported as in run2.sh
alignment.trial_limit_policy: cap 1.5 * 10800 seconds, prorate remaining shared budget before concurrent dispatch
alignment.llm_reference_difference: Original RecHarness run2.sh uses GLM-5.2; user selected local Codex gpt-6.1-sol with medium reasoning effort for these runs.
alignment.search_scope: fixed bert4rec family; six arms, joint tuning and budgeted 2-4-direction combination jumps
alignment.execution_isolation: trusted local processes; test directory omitted from training environment, not an OS filesystem jail

cold_start.origin: identical corrected cold start as same-family MLE-STAR and Self-EvolveRec
cold_start.weights: fresh initialization; no checkpoint or proposal reuse

recharness.jump: up to four unique combinations; best-only basin switch, four retune groups and safe rollback
recharness.memory: version 2 within-run concrete evidence only; no held-out feedback
recharness.execution: same pinned family worker, grader and single-model/family audit as baselines
recharness.transport: same gpt-6.1-sol/medium and four shared LLM slots; bundled CLI; retry/cooldown
recharness.selection: native incumbent after safe jump finalization; final held-out test once

baseline.origin: identical corrected cold start as same-family MLE-STAR and Self-EvolveRec
baseline.weights: fresh initialization; no checkpoint or proposal reuse

base_model.origin: identical corrected cold start as same-family MLE-STAR and Self-EvolveRec
base_model.weights: fresh initialization; no checkpoint or proposal reuse

feature_construction.label: 特征构造
feature_construction.scope: Construct input features solely from supplied training interactions, such as frequency or recency indicators. No external metadata, independent scorer or score fusion. Keep learned embedding design, registered model topology, readout, loss and optimizer fixed.

embedding_representation.label: 嵌入表征
embedding_representation.scope: Item embedding dimensions, parameterization, tying and embedding normalization. Keep feature definitions, interaction/scoring mechanism, registered model topology, history policy, loss and optimizer fixed.

architecture_interaction.label: 架构与交互
architecture_interaction.scope: Coordinate backbone-appropriate blocks (GRU recurrence, NextItNet causal convolution, BERT4Rec masked bidirectional attention, or HSTU gated attention), feed-forward structure, residual paths and jointly trained interaction/scoring formulas such as bilinear compatibility. Keep the registered backbone family, input features, embedding parameterization, sequence selection/readout, loss and optimizer fixed. No independent scorer fusion.

sequence_interest.label: 序列与兴趣
sequence_interest.scope: Coordinate observed-history truncation, position representation and readout of encoder states, including recency or attention pooling. Keep input feature definitions, embedding parameterization, backbone topology, scoring formula, loss and optimizer fixed. Never introduce future interactions or change supplied splits.

learning_objective.label: 学习目标
learning_objective.scope: Ranking/prediction loss, loss weighting and jointly trained auxiliary objectives. Preserve feature definitions, embeddings, registered model topology, scoring/readout, optimizer, sampling, scheduler and batch/epoch settings.

hyperparameter_tuning.label: 联合调参
hyperparameter_tuning.scope: Jointly tune multiple numeric/categorical hyperparameters of the existing program: embedding/hidden dimensions, backbone depth, attention heads where applicable, convolution kernel size where applicable, feed-forward width, max history length, learning rate, dropout, weight decay, batch size, optimizer choice and scheduler settings. A candidate may change any compatible subset together; explain their coupling. Keep the current feature definitions, embedding parameterization/tying, interaction formula, readout formula, loss definition and registered model family. Do not add new computational modules or change data splits, seed 42, epoch cap 200, batches per epoch 200 or GPU/CPU allocation.

arm_policy.regular_routing: one TS draw for each of six arms; select top four without replacement
arm_policy.gpu_budget_allocation: selection frequency allocates slots over rounds; equal per-candidate caps within a group; charge actual worker duration
arm_policy.regular_reward: Bernoulli success iff valid host validation strictly exceeds the group-start local incumbent
arm_policy.jump_routing: budget-safe batch of up to four unique combinations, each with 2-4 directions spanning at least two parents; only best valid candidate opens one retune window
arm_policy.jump_credit: one delayed combination_jump outcome counter; no unidentifiable component-direction credit and no separate prior for each pair
arm_policy.edit_contract: exact selected direction set, per-direction nontrivial AST edits, logged rationale; semantic scope prompt-enforced

memory_policy.archive: per-run immutable observations, source snapshots, outcomes and request contexts
